# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them via GitHub's private [Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/webhook-security-tester/security/advisories/new) feature. Include as much detail as possible: a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.

Please include the affected version, steps to reproduce, and any relevant sanitized logs. Do not include signing secrets, API keys, or production payloads in a report.
